macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: US stocks end lower as chipmakers sell off
items.summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.4% and the Nasdaq 100 dropped 1.2% as weakness in chipmakers and concerns about Nvidia weighed on technology shares. The Dow was little changed, while the 10-year Treasury yield rose two basis points to 5.15%.[3]

items.title: Producer prices rise but come in below expectations
items.summary: US producer prices increased 6.5% year over year in October, the fastest pace since 2022, but the reading was slightly softer than economists expected. Markets nevertheless increased bets on larger or more frequent Federal Reserve rate hikes.[3][4]

items.title: Markets await Fed guidance and Nvidia earnings
items.summary: US stocks traded in a narrow range as investors awaited Nvidia’s earnings and minutes from the Federal Reserve’s latest policy meeting. Two Fed policymakers said it was prudent to wait several more months before beginning rate cuts until inflation is clearly moving toward 2%.[1]

items.title: Nvidia leadership concerns pressure technology shares
items.summary: Nvidia-related concerns contributed to a broad technology selloff, with the Nasdaq Composite down 0.91% and the S&P 500 down 0.40% in the reported session. The developments also raised questions about implications for AI-industry supply chains and US chip-export policy.[4]

items.title: IBM, Eli Lilly and Palo Alto Networks move on company news
items.summary: IBM gained 2.2% after announcing plans to release a family of AI models as open-source software, while Eli Lilly rose 2.5% after Chinese approval for tirzepatide. Palo Alto Networks fell 3.4% after its quarterly billings forecast disappointed investors.[1]

items.title: AstraZeneca announces $2.5 billion China investment
items.summary: AstraZeneca said it will invest $2.5 billion in a Beijing research and development center through a partnership with Chinese authorities.[6]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Crypto markets fall as liquidations reach $845 million
items.summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum declined about 1.6% and 1.5% over the past 24 hours, while several major altcoins fell as much as 3.1%. Total crypto liquidations reached approximately $845 million, with long positions accounting for about $708 million.[1][2]

items.title: KAVA plunges more than 40% amid suspected security issue
items.summary: KAVA dropped over 40% in roughly one hour to about $0.04 amid suspected on-chain security concerns. South Korean exchange Upbit issued a trading alert for the token.[2]

items.title: Binance publishes zero-knowledge proof of reserves
items.summary: Binance announced that it had generated zero-knowledge proofs for its asset reserves, allowing users to independently verify that reported holdings are backed 1:1.[2]

items.title: Solana spot ETF records $3.07 million outflow
items.summary: Solana’s spot exchange-traded funds recorded approximately $3.07 million in net outflows on November 13, with Fidelity’s FSOL accounting for the full daily decline.[3]

items.title: Solana launches Confidential Compute beta
items.summary: The Solana Foundation launched Confidential Compute on Devnet, a tool designed for private AI applications using on-chain hardware-attestation verification, in collaboration with Nito AI.[3]

items.title: Telegram activates more than 1 million self-custodial wallets
items.summary: Telegram founder Pavel Durov said more than 1 million self-custodial wallets were activated within 48 hours, with wallets automatically enabled when users receive Grams.[3]

items.title: Coinbase receives approval for national trust company
items.summary: Coinbase received final approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to charter Coinbase National Trust Company, strengthening its position in crypto custody services.[4]

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Anthropic announces Claude Meetings beta
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings beta for Team and Enterprise customers, allowing Claude to participate visibly in Google Meet calls and produce live notes, action items, documents and whiteboards.

items.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available
items.summary: Google reportedly opened Gemini 4 Carbon to subscribers and API users, with introductory pricing available through November 30.

items.title: Meta releases Muse Ember model
items.summary: Meta reportedly released Muse Ember, a smaller, lower-cost model designed for repetitive agent tasks and cost-sensitive deployments.

items.title: Researchers propose MAEMs for language-model interpretability
items.summary: A new research proposal uses model-generated examples to interpret residual-stream directions in language models. Initial experiments reportedly found that a Qwen3.6-27B-based system could outperform corpus search on several interpretability tasks.

items.title: Runway releases open-weight Praxis-1 robot-control model
items.summary: Runway reportedly released Praxis-1 under the Apache 2.0 license. The model maps camera images, text instructions and robot-position data to robot movements.

items.title: Google Research reports progress on collaborative AI proof systems
items.summary: Google’s Antigravity teamwork tools reportedly used a Long Proof workflow to prove a 2013 information-theory conjecture in full generality, highlighting continued progress in AI-assisted mathematics and engineering.

items.title: LangChain raises $300 million at $3 billion valuation
items.summary: LangChain reportedly closed a $300 million Series C led by CapitalG, with participation from GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP and Sapphire Ventures.

items.title: MiniMax open-sources H3-Image
items.summary: MiniMax reportedly open-sourced H3-Image, a 33-billion-parameter image-generation model designed to render 4K images in six steps.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Ubisoft reportedly greenlights new Rainbow Six: Vegas sequel
items.summary: Ubisoft Montreal has reportedly begun development on a new Rainbow Six: Vegas game, nearly two decades after the previous installment. The project is reportedly codenamed Spades and has not been formally announced by Ubisoft.

items.title: FNCS 2026 Global Championship draws more than one million peak viewers
items.summary: Fortnite’s 2026 Global Championship in Belgium reportedly peaked at over one million viewers. Egor “SwizzY” Luciko and Wilmer “Pixie” Juriander won the event and a $400,000 prize.

items.title: The Game Awards to reveal 2026 nominees on November 17
items.summary: The Game Awards will announce its 2026 nominees in a livestream two days before Grand Theft Auto VI launches. The event will include the Game of the Year nominees along with recognized games, studios and creators.

items.title: YouTube plans 24-hour global GTA VI launch livestream
items.summary: YouTube announced a 24-hour global gaming livestream tied to the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI, alongside limited-edition digital gifts and other platform activations.

items.title: Xsolla acquires GamePix to expand browser-game distribution
items.summary: Xsolla has acquired browser-game publisher GamePix, combining GamePix’s web distribution network with Xsolla’s payments infrastructure across more than 200 markets.

items.title: Nintendo releases Ocarina of Time update for Switch 2
items.summary: Nintendo reportedly deployed version 1.1.1 for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2. The 343 MB update adds Zelda Notes companion support and addresses launch issues.
